name.zh: WE-T800 多功能现场监测仪

manufacturer.zh: 海南世电科技有限公司

description.en: Industrial field monitor with 4G connectivity, RS485 Modbus-RTU, two analog inputs (4–20 mA), two digital inputs, IP68 enclosure, and MQTT/HTTP/WEST cloud protocols.
description.zh: 工业级现场监测仪，支持4G通信、RS485 Modbus-RTU、两路模拟量输入（4-20 mA）、两路数字量输入，IP68防护，支持MQTT/HTTP/WEST云协议。

lead.en: A sealed IP68 field unit for distributed monitoring: 4G backhaul, RS485 Modbus-RTU, two 4–20 mA analog channels, two digital inputs, and flexible power from internal Li-ion packs or 9–30 V DC. Built for water utilities, environmental sites, and industrial IoT where reliability matters.
lead.zh: 一款密封IP68现场监测单元，适用于分布式监控：4G回传、RS485 Modbus-RTU、两路4-20 mA模拟通道、两路数字输入，内置锂电池或9-30V DC灵活供电。专为水务、环保和工业物联网等高可靠性场景设计。

product.og_description: IP68 4G field device: RS485, AI, DI, cloud protocols with MQTT/HTTP.

text.en: LTE FDD/TDD bands supported; MQTT, HTTP, and WEST cloud protocols; 3-year cellular data plan option.
text.zh: 支持LTE FDD/TDD频段；MQTT、HTTP和WEST云协议；可选3年蜂窝数据套餐。

text.en: 1× RS485 (4800–115200 bps, Modbus-RTU), 2× AI (4–20 mA), 2× DI (switch or pulse counting), 2× configurable DC outputs.
text.zh: 1路RS485（4800-115200 bps，Modbus-RTU），2路AI（4-20 mA），2路DI（开关或脉冲计数），2路可配置DC输出。

text.en: IP68 enclosure; 60×32 mm LCD with LED indicators and keypad for local readings and alarms.
text.zh: IP68防护外壳；60x32 mm LCD显示屏，LED指示灯和键盘，支持本地读数与报警。

text.en: Internal Li-ion options (114000 or 228000 mAh) with automatic handover to 9–30 V DC external supply.
text.zh: 内置锂电池可选（114000或228000 mAh），自动切换至9-30V DC外部供电。

text.en: Bluetooth for local configuration; companion app for remote visibility.
text.zh: 蓝牙本地配置；配套APP远程查看。

text.en: Sampling and upload periods configurable from 10 s to 18 h to match battery life and network duty cycle.
text.zh: 采样和上传周期可配置10秒至18小时，匹配电池寿命和网络占空比。

value.en: WE-T800 multi-function monitor / RTU-style field unit
value.zh: WE-T800 多功能监测仪/RTU式现场单元

value.en: 4G LTE; SMA female antenna; MQTT, HTTP, WEST cloud
2× DC output ports, 3.6 V / 5 V / 12 V selectable

value.zh: 内置锂电池：114000 mAh或228000 mAh

value.en: 9–30 V DC (typical 24 V), auto-changeover with battery
60×32 mm LCD, status LEDs, keypad, Bluetooth for provisioning
value.zh: 60x32 mm LCD，状态LED，键盘，蓝牙配置

text.en: Smart water and pipeline monitoring: consolidate analog, digital, and serial field devices into a single 4G-capable uplink.
text.zh: 智慧水务和管道监测：将模拟、数字和串口现场设备整合到单一4G上行链路中。

text.en: Remote supervision for pumps, treatment skids, and distributed assets where Modbus-RTU sensors must be bridged to cloud SCADA or MQTT/HTTP endpoints.
text.zh: 对泵站、处理撬块和分布式资产进行远程监控，将Modbus-RTU传感器桥接到云端SCADA或MQTT/HTTP终端。
